title: ഹോമിയോപ്പതിയിലെ വന്ധ്യതാ ചികിത്സ The Science Brigade
description:
#thesciencebrigade #palebluethoughts #homeopathy 

This is a live recording of the discussion on the treatment for Infertility in Homeopathy which was conducted by The Science Brigade on Sat, 30th October 2021 in Clubhouse. This discussion clearly explains the whole process of how and why infertility happens starting from an explanation of female and male genitalia, reasons for infertility, how modern medicines treat infertility and why treating infertility using sugar pills will not work and how homeopathy claim to manage to achieve this impossible feat. 

This recording is made public after receiving permission from the speakers and TSB. This recording is in Malayalam
